purpose: Independent reproduction and checking of the frozen one-date point-forecast consumer slice from R21 raw inputs.

methods.features: 96 store-item indicators; 56 item-weekday indicators; 8 item time trends in 30-day units from 2026-05-01; 8 item announced-promotion values; one global holiday value scaled by 0.3; nonnegative truncation
methods.unknown_promotion: mean announced promotion per item among prior 56 calendar day training rows; otherwise zero

methods.statistic: median by store, item, and Monday-zero weekday

recompute_checks: input identity against frozen locks and slice source hashes
point-in-time training snapshot and actual later-publication boundary
96-key output identity and both independent method predictions
evaluation labels selected only after origin at cutoff
actual_demand/revision/available_at binding and reported point metrics
scope_limits: one origin and one target date only
point forecasts only; no interval, scenario calibration, or replenishment result is present in this slice
does not establish 42-day production, comparative reliability, paper completeness, or future coverage
